gloss: to mention; to go so far as to refer to

definitions.gloss: to mention; to go so far as to refer to
definitions.explanation: For one's remarks to extend to a particular topic in the course of speaking, especially to bring up something beyond the original subject.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}が{将来|しょうらい}のことに{言|い}い{及|およ}んだ。
examples.english: The conversation came to touch on the future.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{他人|たにん}の{私生活|しせいかつ}にまで{言|い}い{及|およ}んだ。
examples.english: He went so far as to comment on others' private lives.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}は{原因|げんいん}だけでなく{今後|こんご}の{対策|たいさく}にも{言|い}い{及|およ}んでいる。
examples.english: The report refers not only to the cause but also to future countermeasures.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive godan verb. Xに{言|い}い{及|およ}ぶ. Compound of {言|い}う (to say) + {及|およ}ぶ (to reach, to extend). Describes a discussion reaching or extending to a topic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話|はなし}が〜に{言|い}い{及|およ}ぶ: for the talk to come around to ~
- 〜にまで{言|い}い{及|およ}ぶ: to go so far as to mention ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {触|ふ}れる: to touch on — a lighter, brief mention; {言|い}い{及|およ}ぶ implies the talk extends there
- {言及|げんきゅう}する: to refer to — a more formal する verb with the same kanji
